mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing @EDamageCalc@ magic damage to surrounding units.

If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ablaze</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking magic damage each second.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Ablaze</titleLeft><mainText>This unit`s Blaze has become unstable and is about to explode!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

BlazeBrand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing 3% of their max Health in magic damage over 4 seconds, and empowering his abilities against them. If Brand kills an enemy that is already ablaze he gains @f5@ mana. Blaze stacks up to three times.

When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, the Blaze becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, dealing @f4@% (+@f3@%) of each nearby enemy's maximum Health in magic damage. That champion cannot stack Blaze again within 4 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing @PercentHealthDamage@% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains @ManaRestore@ mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times.

When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing @ExplosionDamage@ max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_BrandPassive_Tooltip}}

This Ability does increased damage to monsters, up to @JungleMonsterDPSCap@ damage per second increased to @EpicMonsterDPSCap@ against epic jungle monsters.

The explosion caused by the third stack of Ablaze is capped at @JungleMonsterExplosionFlatCap@ against jungle monsters

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand launches a fireball that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions.

If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by @SlowAmount@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Units that are Ablaze take @EmpoweredDamage@ damage instead.
